Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

SPCIFICATION FOR 
SIGNATURE GUIDE FOR VISUALLY IMPAIRED

1. Scope — Prescribes dimensional and other requirements for signature guide used by visually 
impaired persons. 

2* Material — Aluminium alloy conforming to 18:737-1986 'Specification for wrought 
aluminium and aluminium alloy sheet and strip for general engineering purposes ( third revision )\ 
high density polyethylene ( HOPE ) conforming to IS : 7328-1 974 'Specification for high density 
polyethylene materials for moulding and extrusion' or acrylonitrile butadiene styrene ( ABS ). 



3 Shape and Dimenaions •— Typical shape of the signature guide is shown in Fig. 1. 
dimensions of the guide shall be as given in the figure.

4. Workmanahip and Finiah 

4.1 The signature guide shall be free from rough edges and other surface defects. The corners 
shall be well rounded.

4.2 The inside edges of the slit shall be chamfered or rounded. 

4.3 For better grip on the paper» the revwuB surface of the signature guide may be pasted with a 
thin layer of rubber or any other suitable materiel, 

6. Marking — The signature guide shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or 
recognized trademark by raised letters or in braille at a suitable location* 

6.1 Standard Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 
6« Packing — As agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser.
